summary: Otmar Birkenmeier of Ebringen, head of a Birkenmeier family that emigrated to St. Louis in 1855; not the family of Maria Anna Birkenmeier.
bio:
Otmar Birkenmeier was born in 1794 at Ebringen, Breisgau-Hochschwarzwald, Baden-Württemberg, Germany, and died in 1854. He was the head of the Ebringen Birkenmeier family, which emigrated the year after his death: his widow Marie, 48, landed at New Orleans on 19 February 1855 with Magdalena, 26, Caroline, 25, Mathias, 20, Victoria, 18, Marie, 15, Joseph, 9, Therese, 8, and Rosa, 7. The family settled in St. Louis.

This Ebringen family is not the family of Maria Anna Birkenmeier and should not be confused with it.
